verdict.headline: Plan B wins.
verdict.reason: Focusing on a few cities and bringing in sellers early packed listings close together, so nearby buyers could find something and pick it up instead of finding nothing close. Plan B won 30 of 30 runs.

story.persona: You want to sell things you no longer use. You are 43 and you clear out closets and your garage a few times a year. You do not need the money right away and you will wait for a buyer who pays what you ask. You like meeting someone close by but you are wary of strangers and you prefer a quick handover in a public place near you. You work as an office manager.
